lines.en: label toukaspring5:
scene tsukiokasonthecouch1
Two girls on a couch in a house in a town that won’t stop growing — but they were safe within these walls from the clutches of those ever-expanding tendrils that no one ever sees!
lines.zh: 在一座不停扩张的镇上的一栋房子里，两个女孩坐在沙发上——但在这四面墙内，她们安全无虞，躲过了那些无人得见的、不断蔓延的魔爪！

lines.en: They were both very pretty. They were both very kind! But the heart of one was much brighter than the heart of the other.
lines.zh: 她们俩都很漂亮。她们俩都很善良！但其中一个的心，比另一个的明亮得多。

lines.en: And while the color of a heart does not dictate the way and speed with which it beats, it {i}does{/i} paint a mostly accurate picture of whether or not someone can be trusted.
lines.zh: 而「心的颜色」虽不决定心跳的方式和快慢，{i}却{/i}大致准确地画出了一个人值不值得信任。

lines.en: Would “trust” be an important element to this conversation? Who knows?! For they already trusted each other. But did they {i}really?{/i}
lines.zh: 「信任」会是这场对话的关键吗？谁知道呢？！因为她们本就互相信任。但她们{i}真的{/i}信任吗？

lines.en: A mother’s relationship with her daughter can be quite difficult to understand, you know? That said, however — there is nothing like it in the world.
lines.zh: 母女之间的关系，有时候挺难懂的，你知道吗？不过话说回来——世上再没有比它更特别的东西了。

lines.en: And the events that transpire upon this couch are sure to show you just that.
lines.zh: 而即将在这张沙发上发生的事，定会向你证明这一点。

lines.en: : You wanted to speak with me, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你想跟我谈谈，Touka？

lines.en: : Correct, Mother. I had some questions about Sensei that I believe only you will be able to answer.
lines.zh: : 是的，母亲。我有些关于 Sensei 的问题，我相信只有您能解答。

lines.en: : Oh? There’s nothing I can tell you that he {i}can’t,{/i} dear.
lines.zh: : 哦？我能告诉你的，他自己{i}也能{/i}告诉你，亲爱的。

lines.en: : True. But approaching him about the matter is...difficult, considering our relationship. And I know you to be a woman of great influence {i}and{/i} great knowledge.
lines.zh: : 话是没错。但鉴于我们的关系，找他谈这事……有点难。而且我知道您是个既有权势{i}又博闻{/i}的女人。

lines.en: : My dearest daughter, there’s no need for such generosity. Please speak with me as if we’re gossiping over mimosas at Le Coin Français.
lines.zh: : 我最亲爱的女儿，不必这么客气。就当咱们是在「法式角落」边喝含羞草鸡尾酒边聊八卦那样跟我说话吧。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch2
: Is that really okay?
lines.zh: : 真的可以吗？

lines.en: : {i}Of course,{/i} dear. You are my first-born child who I’m sure will one day have a very similar conversation in a very similar position on this very couch.
lines.zh: : {i}当然{/i}，亲爱的。你是我的长女，我相信总有一天，你也会以同样的姿势、在这同一张沙发上，进行一场极为相似的对话。

lines.en: : If you are to {i}become{/i} me, you must first stop holding me to such ridiculous standards. I really {i}am{/i} just another one of the girls at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 要想{i}成为{/i}我，你首先得不再拿那些可笑的标准要求我。说到底，我真的{i}也只是{/i}「那群女孩」中的一个。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch3
: I apologize for the unwanted formality, then. Yes — let us speak as two women deep in the throes of brunch at a cozy French cafe.
lines.zh: : 那我为方才多余的客套道歉。好——就让我们像两个在温馨法式咖啡馆里、深陷早午餐氛围的女人一样交谈吧。

lines.en: : How {i}is{/i} your French, by the way? Have you been practicing?
lines.zh: : 对了，你的法语怎么样了？{i}有{/i}在练吗？

lines.en: : Let us speak not of language until my questions have been answered or acknowledged, Mother.
lines.zh: : 在我的问题得到解答或回应之前，我们先别谈语言，母亲。

lines.en: : You haven’t been, have you?
lines.zh: : 你没在练，对吧？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch4
: I barely have time for anything anymore between my classes here and at school. Which doesn’t even touch upon how much time I’ve needed to spend on the apartment building {i}and{/i} Yasu lately.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿的课和学校的课之间，几乎挤不出时间做别的了。这{i}还{/i}没算上我最近花在公寓楼和 Yasu 身上的时间。

lines.en: : A Tsukioka {i}always{/i} has the time, Touka. You’d be doing yourself a kindness to remember that.
lines.zh: : 月冈家的人{i}永远{/i}「有时间」，Touka。记住这一点对你自己有好处。

lines.en: : Perhaps you are correct...
lines.zh: : 也许您是对的……

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch5
: But still...that has naught to do with the matter at hand.
lines.zh: : 但即便如此……那也跟眼下的问题无关。

lines.en: : Then ask away, dear. But do so with {i}tact.{/i} I’d {i}hate{/i} to belittle someone I have so much respect for behind his back.
lines.zh: : 那就问吧，亲爱的。但请注意{i}措辞{/i}。我{i}可不想{/i}在背后贬低一个我如此敬重的人。

lines.en: : Why {i}do{/i} you have so much respect for him, Mother? Without making him sound like a terrible person...Sensei is, by all accounts, a really {i}terrible{/i} person.
lines.zh: : 母亲，您为什么这么敬重他？我不是要故意把他抹黑……可 Sensei 无论从哪方面看，都真是个{i}烂人{/i}。

lines.en: : Ha! I suppose that, by conventional means, that’s true. But we are not a conventional family, Touka. We don’t share the same values as those outside of our walls.
lines.zh: : 哈！按世俗的标准看，我想那没错。但我们不是世俗之家，Touka。我们跟墙外那些人的价值观不一样。

lines.en: : Which is why, if you are here to expressly ask for permission to sleep with him-
lines.zh: : 所以，如果你来是想特意请求「准许」跟他上床——

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch6
: Mother, no!
lines.zh: : 母亲，不是的！

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch7
: {i}Still{/i} you refuse to believe that’s what you want? I’m so perplexed, dear. If {i}I{/i} were you, I’d be all over that man like Isaac Burns Murphy on Buchanan at the Kentucky Derby.
lines.zh: : 你{i}还是{/i}不肯承认那才是你想要的？我真搞不懂你，亲爱的。{i}我{/i}要是你，早就对他上下其手了，就像肯塔基德比上 Isaac Burns Murphy 驾驭 Buchanan 那样。

lines.en: : That...is another matter entirely! It is not what I wish to discuss.
lines.zh: : 那……完全是另一回事！那不是我想谈的。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch8
: Okaaaay! I’m just saying, dear...wait any longer and someone {i}else{/i} in the family might get to him first.
lines.zh: : 好——吧！我只是说，亲爱的……再拖下去，家里{i}别的{/i}女人可能就先下手了。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch9
: You...wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 您……不会的。

lines.en: : How do you know I’m not speaking about your sister?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我说的不是你妹妹？

lines.en: : But Tsukasa is-
lines.zh: : 可 Tsukasa 是——

lines.en: : To be wed to someone else. I know.
lines.zh: : 要嫁给别人。我知道。

lines.en: : That...is not what I was going to say. But yes, I suppose that much appears to be true as well.
lines.zh: : 那……不是我要说的。不过，是的，我想那事看来也是真的。

lines.en: : Regardless, can we {i}not{/i} speak of the potentialities of my teacher’s sex life within Tsukioka Manor and, instead, speak of his existence in this city as a whole?
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我们能不能{i}别{/i}在月冈宅邸里讨论我老师性生活的种种「可能性」，转而谈谈他这个人在这座城市里的整体存在？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch10
: And what is that supposed to mean, {i}daughter?{/i}
lines.zh: : 这话是什么意思，{i}女儿{/i}？

lines.en: : Recent events within New Hope Cathedral have just...led me to believe that Sensei may possibly bear the same sort of...{i}divine significance{/i} as Yasu.
lines.zh: : 新希望大教堂里最近发生的事……让我开始觉得，Sensei 或许跟 Yasu 一样，带有某种……{i}神圣的意义{/i}。

lines.en: : Divine significance...what an interesting choice of words.
lines.zh: : 「神圣的意义」……这措辞真有意思。

lines.en: : Forgive me, but I’m unsure of how else to describe their shared connection to a seemingly forgotten sect of spiritual wisdom.
lines.zh: : 恕我词穷，我想不出别的说法来形容他们俩共有的、那种与某个「似被遗忘的灵性智慧流派」的联系。

lines.en: : {i}Wisdom{/i} implies that there is some amount of truth to it, Touka. It’s all but more fanatical nonsense at the end of the day — the same way it is with {i}all{/i} religion, dear.
lines.zh: : {i}「智慧」{/i}意味着其中有那么点真实成分，Touka。可说到底，那不过又是些狂热的胡说八道——跟{i}所有{/i}宗教一个样，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Perhaps...but that doesn’t change the fact that there are many things about their respective existences that never cease to perplex me.
lines.zh: : 也许吧……可这改变不了的事实是：他们俩各自的存在里，都有太多始终让我百思不解的地方。

lines.en: : And I {i}know{/i} that you’ve gone to the efforts of researching Sensei’s past, so if there’s something of significance that you may have uncovered...
lines.zh: : 而且我{i}知道{/i}您下功夫查过 Sensei 的过去，所以如果您查到了什么要紧的东西……

lines.en: : Something that could help {i}me{/i} cultivate a better...understanding of who he is, I would greatly appreciate if you shared that knowledge with me.
lines.zh: : 如果您愿意跟{i}我{/i}分享，好让我更……了解他是个什么样的人，我会非常感激。

lines.en: : Touka darling, if you {i}want{/i} to fuck him, just {i}tell{/i} him. All these extra steps you’re taking are making me dizzier than a 1922 Madeira would.
lines.zh: : Touka 亲爱的，你{i}要想{/i}上他，直接跟他{i}说{/i}就行了。你绕这些弯子，比一杯 1922 年的马德拉酒还让我头晕。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch11
: This is {i}not{/i} about sex! Why do you keep making everything about {i}sex?!{/i} Can I not show interest in him {i}apart{/i} from carnal desire?! Is that truly so bad?! So wrong?!
lines.zh: : 这跟性{i}无关{/i}！您为什么总把什么事都扯到{i}性{/i}上？！我就不能出于肉欲{i}之外{/i}的理由对他感兴趣吗？！这真有那么糟吗？！有那么错吗？！

lines.en: : It’s not {i}wrong...{/i}It’s just boring. You have to admit, the man is attractive. {i}Experienced{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 不算{i}错{/i}……只是有点无聊。你得承认，那男人挺有魅力的。也很有{i}经验{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}care{/i} about that! I care about knowing why you’re, for lack of a better term, {i}obsessed{/i} with him! He’s a commoner! He’s {i}nothing!{/i} He’s-
lines.zh: : 我不{i}在乎{/i}那个！我在乎的是弄明白，您为什么——找不到更好的词——对他这么{i}着迷{/i}！他是个平民！他{i}什么都不是{/i}！他是——

lines.en: : Important.
lines.zh: : 重要的。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch12

lines.zh: : ……怎么个重要法？

lines.en: : In what way?
lines.zh: : 在哪方面重要？

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I told you I’d known him since before you were born? Or that he is somehow the key to winning the space war? Or {i}maybe{/i} that he is your long lost older brother! Ooh, that’d be fun!
lines.zh: : 要是我告诉你，早在你出生前我就认识他了，你信吗？或者，他不知怎么竟是赢得「太空战争」的关键？又{i}或者{/i}，他是你失散多年的亲哥哥！哦，那就有意思了！

lines.en: : No! I would not believe any of that. And I ask, no — I {i}beg{/i} that you save jokes like this for a moment where I am {i}not{/i} caught between a rock and a hard place!
lines.zh: : 不！我哪个都不信。而且我请求——不，我{i}恳求{/i}您把这种玩笑留到一个我{i}不是{/i}「进退两难」的时刻！

lines.en: : If only the hard place was his thick, {i}throbbing{/i} member...
lines.zh: : 要是那个「硬地方」是他那根又粗又{i}胀{/i}的家伙就好了……

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch13
: What in the {i}world{/i} has gotten into you?! Why are you acting this way?! It’s like you’re barely my mother at all!
lines.zh: : 您{i}到底{/i}怎么了？！您干嘛这副样子？！这简直不像是我母亲了！

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch14
: Oh, {i}I’m{/i} the one who isn’t myself? Please.
lines.zh: : 哦，反倒是{i}我{/i}「不像自己」了？得了吧。

lines.en: : What is that supposed to-
lines.zh: : 那是什么意——

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch15
: Your charade is as flimsy as a wet paper bag, darling. Why not drop the act now and show me who you really are?
lines.zh: : 你的伪装像浸了水的纸袋一样不堪一击，亲爱的。何不现在就卸了妆，让我看看你到底是谁？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch16
: Ooooh, interesting! I recognize those eyes.
lines.zh: : 哦——有意思！我认得这双眼睛。

lines.en: : How did you know?...
lines.zh: : 您是怎么知道的？……

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch17
: You think I wouldn’t recognize someone masquerading as my own daughter?
lines.zh: : 你以为我会认不出一个冒充我女儿的人？

lines.en: : There’s nothing more important to me in this entire {i}world{/i} than my girls, dear. Surely {i}your{/i} mother is the same, is she not?
lines.zh: : 在这{i}世上{/i}，再没有什么比我的女儿们对我更重要了，亲爱的。{i}你的{/i}母亲肯定也一样，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s...um...
: Let’s cut to the chase — what do you want? What use do you have for Akira?
lines.zh: : 我们开门见山吧——你想要什么？你要 Akira 有什么用？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch18
scene tsukiokasonthecouch19
: What do you think about this place, Miss Tsukioka?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这地方怎么样，Tsukioka 小姐？

lines.en: : Are you happy here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿开心吗？

lines.en: : Why, I haven’t heard {i}that{/i} question in quite some time. Shows you the type of people I commonly associate with, does it not?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，{i}这{/i}问题我可有一阵子没听人问过了。由此可见我平时打交道的都是些什么人，对吧？

lines.en: : Just answer the question, please. I’ve already broken the rules by revealing myself. I shouldn’t stay any longer than I need to.
lines.zh: : 请直接回答问题。我现身就已经破了规矩。不该多待。

lines.en: : How can I answer what can {i}not{/i} be answered at all? Just tell me what you need and I’ll see to it.
lines.zh: : 一个根本{i}没{/i}法回答的问题，你让我怎么答？直接告诉我你需要什么，我来安排。

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I told you I wanted to save the world?
lines.zh: : 要是我告诉你，我想拯救世界，你信吗？

lines.en: : Which one?
lines.zh: : 哪个世界？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch20
: Oh, {i}you’re{/i} good. I guess coming here really {i}was{/i} the right idea after all.
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}你{/i}厉害。看来来这儿果然{i}是{/i}对的。

lines.en: : You must be somewhat desperate if that’s the case, though. It’s been decades since the last time I encountered one of you.
lines.zh: : 不过要真是那样，你多半也挺走投无路的。距离我上次遇到「你们这种人」，已经几十年了。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch21
: I am. But please keep it a secret because I’m {i}really{/i} trying to shake things up.
lines.zh: : 是。但请保密，因为我是{i}真{/i}想搞点大动作。

lines.en: : Ooh, I love secrets! Do tell.
lines.zh: : 哦，我最爱秘密了！快讲。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch22
: {i}Ahem!{/i} I’ve been practicing this pitch for quite some time, so get ready to have your mind blown.
lines.zh: : {i}咳{/i}！这套「说辞」我练了好久了，准备好大开眼界吧。

lines.en: : A business proposition then?
lines.zh: : 那么，是一桩商业提案？

lines.en: : {i}Something{/i} like that.
lines.zh: : {i}差不多{/i}吧。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch23
Blah, blah, blah. Then some stuff happened. Busy now! Gotta go! Bye!
lines.zh: 巴拉巴拉巴拉。然后发生了一些事。现在很忙！得走了！拜！

lines.en: : Do the two of you ever feel as if someone is talking about you behind your back?
lines.zh: : 你们俩有没有过一种感觉，好像有人在背后议论你？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch24
: Every time I sneeze.
lines.zh: : 我每次打喷嚏都有。

lines.en: : Talking about a creature as insignificant as me would be a waste of time and energy! That’s why {i}I{/i} only think about God!
lines.zh: : 议论像我这么微不足道的生物，纯属浪费时间和精力！所以{i}我{/i}只想着上帝！

lines.en: : Why do you ask, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么问，Touka？

lines.en: : I just...can’t help but feel like I’m having some strange sort of...out of body experience right now. Like I’m in two places at once.
lines.zh: : 我只是……忍不住觉得，我现在好像在经历某种奇怪的……「灵魂出窍」。好像我同时身处两个地方。

lines.en: : Is the other place a diner? I hope it’s a diner. I’m really hungry. I want to be there too.
lines.zh: : 另一个地方是小餐馆吗？我希望是。我好饿。我也想去那儿。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch25
: It’s certainly not a diner, but...I’m not quite sure {i}where{/i} it is. Or what.
lines.zh: : 肯定不是小餐馆，但……我也说不清它在{i}哪儿{/i}。或者说是什么。

lines.en: : It’s nowhere specific, surely. It’s more of just a...state of being or...{i}not{/i} being, maybe. Like I’m caught between two separate planes of existence at once.
lines.zh: : 肯定不在任何具体的地方。它更像一种……「存在」的状态，或者也许是{i}「不存在」{/i}。好像我同时被夹在两个不同的位面之间。

lines.en: : Uh-oh! I think Yasuyasu might be rubbing off on you! Tickle tickle tickle!
lines.zh: : 不妙！我觉得 Yasuyasu 好像传染给你了！挠挠挠！

lines.en: : Aah! Stop it, Karin! It feels like there are ladybugs beneath my skin!
lines.zh: : 啊！住手，Karin！感觉像有瓢虫在我皮肤底下爬！

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch26
: Whatever the case, I’m sure it will go away shortly. Perhaps it’s just {i}my{/i} turn to start experiencing intermittent possession and this is {i}my{/i} body’s way of warming me up to it.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我肯定它很快就会过去。也许只是轮到{i}我{/i}开始经历「间歇性附身」了，这是{i}我{/i}身体在帮我「热身」。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch27
: One of us! One of us!
lines.zh: : 我们中的一员！我们中的一员！

lines.en: : Possession? What do you mean it’s {i}your{/i} turn to start being possessed? Isn’t that a horror movie thing?
lines.zh: : 附身？你说「轮到{i}你{/i}开始被附身」是什么意思？那不是恐怖片里的事吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but- oh! Perhaps I should be Linda Blair for next year’s Halloween party? Regardless, it both is and {i}isn’t{/i} a “movie thing.”
lines.zh: : 是，但是——哦！明年的万圣节派对，我或许该扮 Linda Blair？总之，这事既是、也{i}不{/i}全是「电影里的事」。

lines.en: : And I imagine you’ll bear witness to it soon enough if you continue to spend time with Yasu and me as she experiences bouts of something possession-adjacent quite frequently.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，只要你继续跟 Yasu 和我待在一起，你很快就会亲眼见识到——她经常会发作某种「类似附身」的状况。

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch28
: {i}This{/i} little bug?! Getting all scary like that?! Doubt it! She could never even hurt a fly! Could you, Yasu?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}只小不点？！变得那么吓人？！才怪！她连只苍蝇都伤不了！对吧，Yasu？

lines.en: : I could not! For I am but one of them and bringing harm upon myself or my kind would be worth nineteen days in a tub of acid.
lines.zh: : 我伤不了！因为我也是它们中的一员，伤害自己或同类，要在酸液桶里泡十九天！

lines.en: : Just say no next time, kay?
lines.zh: : 下次直接说「不」就行，好吗？

lines.en: : It’s not just me either! It’s Sensei too! We have a “gift!”
lines.zh: : 而且不光是我！Sensei 也是！我们有一种「天赋」！

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch29
: {i}Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei？{/i}

lines.en: : He’s {i}extra{/i} special! He can {i}see{/i} things! I merely become them and carry words from up above to those undeserving who live closer to the ground than the sky!
lines.zh: : 他{i}格外{/i}特别！他能{i}「看见」{/i}东西！我只是「变成」它们，把天上的话带给那些住在离地面比离天空近的、不配的人！

lines.en: : So he...what?
lines.zh: : 所以他……怎样？

lines.en: : You’ve never witnessed something seemingly take him over before?
lines.zh: : 你从没见过有什么东西好像「占据」过他吗？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch30
: ...What?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch31
: Probably just one more case of you not experiencing what essentially everyone else in our class has due to less exposure to him.
lines.zh: : 多半又是「因为你接触他比较少，没经历过班上其他人基本都经历过的事」的又一例。

lines.en: : It’s practically common knowledge to all of us at this point that he has bouts of...{i}decreased{/i} identity. Though, the reasons for this remain as elusive to me as ever.
lines.zh: : 到这地步，他时不时发作的……{i}「自我感减退」{/i}，对我们几乎已是公开的秘密。不过，这背后的原因，对我来说始终成谜。

lines.en: : Perhaps I should refer him to Yasu’s doctor as well? Their cases are slightly different, but I’m sure that-
lines.zh: : 我或许该把他也介绍给 Yasu 的医生？他俩的情况略有不同，但我肯定——

lines.en: : You...You’ve {i}seen{/i} this before, Touka? This...possession thing? What’s it like? Can you tell me? I...I’m just curious! It’s not like...{i}I’ve{/i} actually seen it, but...you know, if I {i}had,{/i} I’d obviously want to {i}know!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……你以前{i}见过{/i}这个，Touka？这种……附身的事？是什么样的？你能告诉我吗？{i}我{/i}……我只是好奇！又不是说……我真的见过，不过……你懂的，要是我{i}见过{/i}，我肯定想{i}知道{/i}！

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch32
: You’d be better off asking Ayane than me. He seldom acts that way in my presence. {i}Probably{/i} because he thinks I’m his mother and is comforted by my existence. I hate it.
lines.zh: : 你问 Ayane 比问我强。他在我面前很少那样。{i}多半{/i}因为他把我当他母亲，我的存在让他安心。我讨厌这样。

lines.en: : Ayane...yeah.
lines.zh: : Ayane……哦。

lines.en: : She...knows stuff about him. I’ll...ask {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她……知道些他的事。我……去问{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : You {i}have{/i} witnessed it, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你{i}其实{/i}见过，对吧？

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch33
: No!
lines.zh: : 没有！

lines.en: scene tsukiokasonthecouch34
: ...maybe.
lines.zh: : ……也许吧。

lines.en: : Well, on the off chance you {i}haven’t,{/i} you will soon enough. And I do ask that you don’t hold it against him as I imagine there’s no one who hates it more than {i}he{/i} does.
lines.zh: : 好吧，万一你真{i}没见过{/i}，你迟早会见的。而且我请你别因为这个怪他——因为我想，这世上没有人比{i}他自己{/i}更讨厌这个了。

lines.en: : You...think he’s a good person then?
lines.zh: : 你……觉得他是个好人，是吗？

lines.en: : Now...I don’t know if I’d go {i}that{/i} far. But I don’t think he means any harm.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……我不确定我愿不愿说到{i}那份上{/i}。但我不觉得他心怀恶意。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: scene black
: Maybe...he doesn’t...
lines.zh: : 也许……他没有恶意……

lines.en: Back! Sorry. What did I- oh, darn. Over already?
lines.zh: 回来了！抱歉。我刚才——哦，糟。已经结束了？

lines.en: Guess I’ll just get out of here, then! Later!
lines.zh: 那我还是撤了吧！回头见！

lines.en: Hope you enjoyed being one of the girls!
lines.zh: 希望你们享受「成为女孩们中的一员」！
